data.body: Root-cause update: the 'cancelled' state on the llm-review check was caused by hitting the 20-minute job timeout, not by an upstream cancellation event. The timeout fired because PR #284 is a single 76-commit cumulative PR (158K of diff) — too large for the reviewer to complete in a single pass. This connects the mis-classification (filed here) to the per-story-PR violation (c7d1-8025-d4d9-428e), the unparented-task root cause (50f6-72c7-e421-40f0), and the cycle-mismatch warning (c6bf-19df-ac83-43fb): had per-story PRs been opened as intended, each would have been small enough for llm-review to complete within budget. The fix for pr-finalize-classify.sh should still distinguish 'cancelled (timeout)' from 'BLOCKED_BY_REVIEW (missing reviewer)' and route the former to a re-trigger; the underlying timeout cause is upstream.
